proofLimits: Two new evidence-review archive/source profiles. Closed file-review, hosting and older packets are not replayed.

React 19.2.8 and TypeScript 5.9.3, four installed SourceList/evidence SSR profiles and strict public types. The native dialog is closed on SSR; only separate browser checks can establish actual modality, focus, dismissal or stacking. No browser, source verification, fetching, persistence, external MCP host, permission grant or model execution in this helper.
Seven locally generated archives are not public npm package-name installs. Fresh transitive locks are retained rather than equated with the workspace lock.
The outer supervisor owns namespace scanning and final scratch removal. This helper checks its direct children, streams and original process groups.
